title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Summer Dream 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Summer Dream brings together a medley of vibrant Summer Fruits for a bright and uplifting vape. Bursting with layers of ripe, juicy flavours, this blend captures the essence of sun-drenched berries and tropical fruits for a complex yet perfectly balanced fruity vape. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers a consistently smooth throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour with discreet vapour production, making it an excellent match for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
